extracted.name: Berry protein smoothie
extracted.description: Snack like a sports champ with a berry smoothie to beat the mid-morning slump. It features added protein to power you through until lunchtime
ingredient_lines: 350ml soya milk or another milk of your choice
1 tbsp pea protein powder or another protein powder of your choice (optional)
instruction_lines: Peel the banana and put it in a blender. Add the other ingredients, along with a couple of ice cubes. Put the lid on and blend until smooth, then pour into two glasses and enjoy. Will keep chilled for up to a day.
